senses.gloss:
शनैस् ind.
—1 Slowly, gently, quietly.
—2 Gradually, by degrees, little by little; धर्मं संचिनुयाच्छनैः;
 Ku. 3. 59; Ms. 3. 217.
—3 Successively, in due order; विषयाणां ग्रहीतॄणि शनैः पञ्चेन्द्रियाणि
 च Ms. 1. 15.
—4 Mildly, softly.
—5 Tardily, sluggishly. —6 Independently. (शनैः शनैः slowly, by slow degrees).
.━{@Comp.@}: शनैश्चर

शनैस् + -चर a. going or moving slowly; शनैश्चराभ्यां पादाभ्यां
 रेजे ग्रहमयीव सा Bh. 1. 17 (where it means ‘Saturn’ also).

शानैश्चर a. (-री f.)
—1 Relating to Saturn.
—2 Falling on a Saturday.
